name: Music Mouse
shortDesc: An interactive musical canvas inspired by Laurie Spiegel's 1986 classic. Move your mouse — make music. No keyboard, no notes, no rules.

updates.note: Initial release — interactive canvas, Web Audio API, Laurie Spiegel-inspired
updates.label: v1 released

name: RPS Battle
shortDesc: Real-time multiplayer Rock Paper Scissors battle game with virtual coins. No real money — a reminder that the thrill of betting never needs to cost you anything.

updates.label: v1.0
updates.note: Released: real-time multiplayer battles with virtual coins only. The source code is kept private on purpose.

name: Je už Bitcoin za 100k?
shortDesc: Is Bitcoin at $100K yet? One page, one answer: yes or no. The oldest project here, made with ChatGPT in November 2024. In Czech.

updates.label: Live
updates.note: Released: one page that checks every 15 minutes whether Bitcoin is at $100K yet.

name: Random Thoughts Podcast
shortDesc: Every Friday, one random thought, followed all the way down: strange true stories from history, science and the human mind. Research and scripts by AI, reviewed by a human; all voices are AI-generated.

updates.label: Season 2
updates.note: Season 2 started: new episodes on Fridays, made with a new workflow.

name: COVID-19 Timelapse
shortDesc: The pandemic week by week on an interactive 3D globe: reported cases and deaths, vaccination and government measures, from WHO, OxCGRT and Our World in Data.

updates.label: Started
updates.note: Work started on a 3D globe that plays the whole pandemic week by week.
